text:
What the fuck can I do with my knee,

with my long skinny leg,

with my arms, with my tongue,

with my skinny eyes?

What can I do in this whirlpool

of well-meaning imbeciles?

What can I do with rotten clever people

and with sweet girls who want poetry instead of a man?

What can I do among poets dressed in the uniforms

of the academy or of communism?

What, among salesmen or politicians

or shepherds of souls?

What the fuck can I do, Tarumba,

if I'm neither saint nor hero nor bandit,

nor worshipper of art,

nor pharmacist,

nor rebel?

What can I do if I can do anything

and all I feel like doing is looking and looking?

translation.title: What the Fuck Can I Do with My Knee?...
